The story begins with an intense discussion about the legitimacy of rulers and societal structures. The conversation explores the concept of the cosmic being (Virat Purusha) and how different social classes emerged from its body—Brahmins from the mouth, Kshatriyas from the arms, Vaishyas from the thighs, and Shudras from the feet. This symbolism was meant to represent different roles in society rather than a rigid caste hierarchy.
